mapper.select: SELECT MAX(wm.role) FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0

SELECT p.project_id, p.subject AS project_name FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND p.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY p.project_id DESC

SELECT t.task_id, t.project_id, t.title AS task_name FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id JOIN workspace_domains wd ON wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY t.task_id DESC
mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND ( (n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id) OR (n.notice_type = 'PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id )) OR (n.notice_type = 'TASK' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id WHERE t.task_id = n.task_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id )) ) AND ( (n.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(n.status, 1) != 0) OR wm.role >= 80 ) )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{requester_member_id} AND wm.status = 0 AND ( (n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND wm.role = 70) OR (n.notice_type = 'PROJECT' AND wm.role >= 50 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = n.project_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL )) OR (n.notice_type = 'TASK' AND wm.role >= 50 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id WHERE t.task_id = n.task_id AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL )) ) )

if.test: noticeType != null and noticeType != '' and noticeType != 'all'

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT n.notice_id, n.workspace_id, n.project_id, n.task_id, n.member_id, n.notice_type, n.title, n.status, n.view_count, TO_CHAR(n.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, md.name AS member_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_files f WHERE f.notice_id = n.notice_id) AS file_count FROM notice n LEFT JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = n.member_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT n.notice_id, n.workspace_id, n.project_id, n.task_id, n.member_id, n.notice_type, n.title, n.content, n.status, n.view_count, TO_CHAR(n.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, TO_CHAR(n.updated, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated, md.name AS member_name, p.subject AS project_name, t.title AS task_name FROM notice n LEFT JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = n.member_id LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = n.project_id LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.task_id = n.task_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id}

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title FROM notice n WHERE n.notice_id > #{notice_id}
ORDER BY n.notice_id ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title FROM notice n WHERE n.notice_id < #{notice_id}
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT seq_notice.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO notice ( notice_id, notice_type, workspace_id, project_id, task_id, member_id, title, content, status, view_count, created ) SELECT #{notice_id}, #{notice_type}, wd.workspace_id, CASE WHEN #{notice_type} IN ('PROJECT', 'TASK') THEN p.project_id ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{notice_type} = 'TASK' THEN t.task_id ELSE NULL END, #{requester_member_id}, #{title}, #{content}, 1, 0, SYSDATE FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = #{project_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND p.deleted IS NULL LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.task_id = #{task_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND t.project_id = p.project_id AND t.deleted IS NULL WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{requester_member_id} AND wm.status = 0 AND ( (#{notice_type} = 'WORKSPACE' AND wm.role = 70)
OR (#{notice_type} = 'PROJECT' AND wm.role >= 50 AND p.project_id IS NOT NULL)
OR (#{notice_type} = 'TASK' AND wm.role >= 50 AND t.task_id IS NOT NULL) )
mapper.update: UPDATE notice n SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated = SYSDATE WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(n.status, 1) != 0
UPDATE notice n SET status = 0, updated = SYSDATE WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(n.status, 1) != 0
mapper.select:
SELECT f.notice_file_id, f.notice_id, f.original_name, f.stored_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, TO_CHAR(f.uploaded, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS uploaded FROM notice_files f JOIN notice n ON n.notice_id = f.notice_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id}
ORDER BY f.notice_file_id

SELECT f.notice_file_id, f.notice_id, f.original_name, f.stored_name, f.file_path, f.file_size FROM notice_files f JOIN notice n ON n.notice_id = f.notice_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND f.notice_file_id = #{notice_file_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_files ( notice_file_id, notice_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded ) SELECT seq_notice_files.NEXTVAL, n.notice_id, #{original_name}, #{stored_name}, #{file_path}, #{file_size}, SYSDATE FROM notice n WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(n.status, 1) != 0
